title: WEWISPs: ISP management platform
summary: User management, billing and network monitoring for an internet service provider.
impact: Fewer support tickets and more efficient customer management.
problem: An internet service provider needed one platform for user management, billing and network monitoring across a large user base.
solution: Built an end-to-end ISP management system with billing modules, network-monitoring dashboards, stable backend workflows and browser-compatible UI components.
result: Improved customer management efficiency and reduced overhead and support ticket volume.
